items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Do you know any of the Rosenmeier's? ... [INTERVIEWEE]: No, I don't.

ctx.x: All right. You ask Tom about me, and Tom will tell you a whole lot about me. Did he work for you? Yes, Tom played music and me.
Yeah. I've heard him talk about the harmony band, you know. Yeah. He had that band. Yeah. Do you know any of the Rosenmeier's? No. Rosenmeier? Rosenmeier, I think they've worked for him. No, I don't.
I know the Korns, Marcus and Navi, Korn. What did they play? Trombone and Paranet. Marty, Marty played Paranet. Marcus played Trombone.
